controles.affirmation: L'acquisition de JRD ajoute 'jusqu'a 6,3 Mds $ de dette nouvelle' (hook, resume et titre du 4e argument interne)
controles.verbatim_source: Sysco has agreed to pay approximately $29.1 billion to JRD shareholders, comprising of approximately $21.6 billion in cash... Sysco has executed a commitment letter for a $22 billion senior unsecured 364-day bridge loan facility... Subsequent to the execution of the commitment letter... Sysco entered into a $3 billion senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility... reducing the bridge loan facility commitments from $22 billion to $19 billion. / We have executed cash-settled deal contingent rate lock transactions to mitigate interest rate risk on $6.3 billion of future permanent debt that could potentially be issued to finance the purchase of JRD.
controles.correction_proposee: Les 6,3 Mds$ sont le notionnel des couvertures de taux, pas le montant de la dette nouvelle. La partie cash de l'operation atteint environ 21,6 Mds$, adossee a un pret relais de 19 Mds$ et a un pret a terme de 3 Mds$. Ecrire : 'une partie cash d'environ 21,6 Mds$ a financer, dont 6,3 Mds$ de dette future deja couverts en taux'. Le corps du 4e argument interne est deja correct sur ce point, seuls le hook, le resume et le titre sont a corriger.

controles.affirmation: Les 2 230 415 actions rachetees representent 'environ 19% du nombre de titres rachetes' rapportes aux 91,5 millions d'actions nouvelles JRD
controles.verbatim_source: We repurchased 2,230,415 shares for $200 million during the first 39 weeks of fiscal 2026. / 91.5 million shares of Sysco common stock.
controles.correction_proposee: Le rapport reel est 2 230 415 / 91 500 000 = 2,4%, soit environ 41 fois moins d'actions rachetees que d'actions a emettre. Le chiffre de 19% ne correspond a aucun ratio du document. Ecrire : 'les rachats representent 2,4% du nombre d'actions a emettre pour JRD'.

controles.affirmation: T3 FY2026 : resultat net -15,2% a 340 M$, BPA dilue -13,4% a 0,71 $, BPA ajuste -2,1% a 0,94 $, resultat operationnel 681 -> 619 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Operating income: decreased 9.1%, or $62 million, to $619 million / Net earnings: decreased 15.2%, or $61 million, to $340 million / Diluted earnings per share: decreased 13.4% or $0.11, to $0.71 per share; adjusted diluted earnings per share decreased 2.1%, or $0.02, to $0.94 per share

controles.affirmation: Charges du Global Support Center de 183 M$ a 261 M$ (+42,6%), premiere cause de la baisse du resultat operationnel
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau segments 13 semaines closes le 28 mars 2026 : 'Total segment operating income 880 / Global Support Center (261) / Total operating income 619' ; 13 semaines closes le 29 mars 2025 : 'Total segment operating income (loss) 864 / Global Support Center (183) / Total operating income 681'. Le resultat des segments progresse de 16 M$ alors que le GSC se degrade de 78 M$. Verbatim charges : 'Operating expenses increased primarily due to higher incentive compensation, sales headcount investments, increased acquisition and due diligence costs'.

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres 2 297 M$ pour un bilan de 27 983 M$ ; dette long terme 12 818 M$ contre 12 360 M$ neuf mois plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan au 28 mars 2026 / 28 juin 2025 : Long-term debt 12,818 / 12,360 ; Total shareholders' equity 2,297 / 1,830 ; Total liabilities and shareholders' equity $27,983 / $26,774.

controles.affirmation: 91,5 millions d'actions emises, environ 16% du capital pour les actionnaires de JRD, indemnite de rupture de 1,164 Md$ si les autorisations reglementaires ne sont pas obtenues
controles.verbatim_source: 91.5 million shares of Sysco common stock. Following the transaction, JRD's equity holders are expected to hold approximately 16% of the outstanding common stock of Sysco in the aggregate. / If the Merger Agreement is terminated due to a failure to obtain required regulatory clearances, Sysco has agreed to pay JRD a termination fee of $1.164 billion.

controles.affirmation: International Foodservice : ventes +12,4%, resultat operationnel de 96 M$ a 83 M$, couts de restructuration principalement en Europe (Royaume-Uni, France, Irlande, Suede)
controles.verbatim_source: Sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 12.4% as compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2025. Tableaux segments : 83 (T3 FY2026) vs 96 (T3 FY2025). Note : 'Includes restructuring and transformation initiative costs primarily in Europe.' / 'Our European operations primarily consist of operations in the United Kingdom (U.K.), France, Ireland and Sweden'.

controles.affirmation: Facteurs de risque sur le mix de clientele et les GPO
controles.verbatim_source: the risk that if sales from our locally managed customers do not grow at the same rate as sales from multi-unit customers, our gross margins may decline / the risk that competition in our industry and the impact of GPOs may adversely impact our margins
controles.correction_proposee: Ces deux phrases figurent dans la liste des facteurs de risque des declarations prospectives du 10-Q, pas dans une section 'Risk Factors' dediee. La mention 'Sysco identifie explicitement comme facteur de risque' reste exacte.

controles.affirmation: T4 FY2026 : BPA GAAP 1,15 $ (+4,5%) contre BPA ajuste 1,53 $ ; marge operationnelle GAAP 4,44%, +23 points de base
controles.verbatim_source: EPS increased 4.5% to $1.15, and adjusted EPS increased 3.4% to $1.53 / Operating margin (GAAP) 4.44 % 4.21 % 23 bps. Ecart 1,53 vs 1,15 : 24,8% de l'ajuste, coherent avec les 25,7% calcules de la meme facon sur 1,48 vs 1,10.
controles.correction_proposee: Le champ _sources indique que l'exhibit 99.1 n'est pas dans le data-lake alors que data-lake/SYY/8K/SYY_2026-08-04_0000096021-26-000026_EX-99.1.htm.gz existe et contient bien ces chiffres. Metadonnee a corriger.

controles.affirmation: 778 M$ de dividendes verses sur 39 semaines contre 1 206 M$ de resultat net, soit environ 65% de distribution
controles.verbatim_source: Dividends paid in the first 39 weeks of fiscal 2026 were $778 million, or $1.62 per share, as compared to $752 million... Etat des capitaux propres : Net earnings 1,206. Recalcul : 778/1206 = 64,5%.

controles.affirmation: Covenant EBITDA consolide / charge d'interets de 3,0x sur le nouveau credit renouvelable
controles.verbatim_source: The new facility includes a covenant requiring Sysco to maintain a ratio of consolidated EBITDA to consolidated interest expense of 3.0 to 1.0 over four consecutive fiscal quarters, which is consistent with our previous revolving credit facility.

note: Aucune affirmation judiciaire inexacte. Les deux fautes portent sur des chiffres spectaculaires : le montant de la dette nouvelle JRD et un ratio de rachats d'actions incoherent.
